assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
